short: dType Storage Extension for the EVM
introduction: ERC-2157 defines an optional storage extension for dType, the decentralized type system from ERC-1900, standardizing the ABI of the contracts that store type instances. It was proposed by Loredana Cirstea and Christian Tzurcanu in June 2019. Each storage contract exposes a common CRUD interface that makes every record addressable by a deterministic identifier or by index. Note: ERC-2157 is Stagnant — it has been inactive for 6+ months and may never be finalized, but remains historically or technically significant.
designPurpose: ERC-2157 was designed to give Ethereum deterministic addressability for public data. ERC-1900 standardized type definitions but left data retrieval to off-chain blockchain analysis or centralized caches like block explorers, so on-chain contracts could not reliably locate another project's instances. By fixing a common storage ABI and a TypeRootContract that ties each type to its library and storage, ERC-2157 lets any contract or tool follow a known path to a record and reconstruct its ABI from the dType registry.
commonUsage: The extension targets applications built on shared public data: decentralized marketplaces that read product records straight from a known storage contract, data bridges that sync type instances between Ethereum shards or across chains, and tooling that infers a contract's ABI from the registry. The proposal defers access and mutability controls to a future extension. Because ERC-2157 never reached Final status, it saw only reference-implementation work rather than production adoption.
fn.insert.desc: Stores a new type instance, writing it into the record mapping and appending it to the index array. Returns the primary identifier computed by the type library's getIdentifier function and emits a LogNew event.
fn.insert.params.data: The type instance to store, typed by the contract's type library.
fn.insert.returns.identifier: The record's primary identifier, derived from its values by getIdentifier.
fn.insertBytes.desc: Stores a new type instance supplied as ABI-encoded bytes, decoding it with the type library before writing the record.
fn.insertBytes.params.data: The ABI-encoded type instance to store.
fn.insertBytes.returns.identifier: The primary identifier of the stored record.
fn.remove.desc: Deletes the record with the given identifier and frees its storage slot, returning the index the record occupied.
fn.remove.params.identifier: The primary identifier of the record to remove.
fn.remove.returns.index: The index the removed record occupied in the index array.
fn.update.desc: Overwrites the record stored under the given identifier with new type instance values, returning the identifier of the updated record.
fn.update.params.identifier: The primary identifier of the record to update.
fn.update.params.data: The new type instance values to store.
fn.update.returns.identifier: The identifier of the updated record.
fn.isStored.desc: Reports whether a record with the given identifier exists in the storage contract.
fn.isStored.returns.stored: True if a record with the identifier exists.
fn.getByHash.desc: Returns the type instance stored under the given primary identifier.
fn.getByHash.params.identifier: The primary identifier of the record to fetch.
fn.getByIndex.desc: Returns the type instance stored at the given position in the index array, allowing records to be enumerated.
fn.getByIndex.params.index: The position of the record in the index array.
fn.count.desc: Returns the number of records currently stored in the contract.
fn.count.returns.counter: The total number of stored records.
fn.LogNew.desc: Emitted when a new type instance is inserted into the storage contract.
fn.LogNew.params.identifier: The primary identifier of the inserted record.
fn.LogNew.params.index: The index of the record in the index array.
fn.LogUpdate.desc: Emitted when an existing record is updated.
fn.LogUpdate.params.identifier: The primary identifier of the updated record.
fn.LogUpdate.params.index: The index of the record in the index array.
fn.LogRemove.desc: Emitted when a record is removed from the storage contract.
fn.LogRemove.params.identifier: The primary identifier of the removed record.
fn.LogRemove.params.index: The index the removed record occupied in the index array.
sim.insertWalkthrough.name: Store a Type Instance Walkthrough
sim.insertWalkthrough.desc: Follow an insert call from the publisher through record storage to the LogNew event.
sim.insertWalkthrough.step.call: The publisher calls insert(data) with a type instance to add to the storage contract.
sim.insertWalkthrough.step.execute: The contract derives the identifier with the type library's getIdentifier function, writes the record into the typeStruct mapping, and appends its identifier to the typeIndex array.
sim.insertWalkthrough.step.event: The contract emits LogNew(identifier, index) so off-chain indexers can track the new record.
